sites_empty: No sites have joined yet. Share a class code to get started.
remove_site_body: The site keeps the objects it received; they become ordinary objects. Course staff are removed from its team, and the group keeps working on its own.
codes_access_note: A code controls who can join this course, not who can see its material. The images stay on the servers their manifests point at, and Telar cannot restrict access to them. If those servers serve the images publicly, a join code or story key will not make those images private. Add only material you are free to publish.
code_role_collaborator: Class code — students enter it to attach their sites
code_role_instructor: Staff code — whoever enters it joins the course as an instructor
code_label_hint: So you can tell codes apart, e.g. "Section B".
revoke_code_body: No one else will be able to use it. Sites and staff it already admitted are not affected.
